citation: MIL-STD-810H Method 514.8 Category 4 composite wheeled-vehicle exposure (Tables 514.8C-VII/VIII), adapted for installed equipment per Category 20 (Annex D para 2.9; its exposure-levels paragraph 20.c points wheeled vehicles at the Category 4 curves). Cat 4 is a secured-cargo category, and the 7-8 Hz dominant / 14-16 Hz secondary peak labels are this design's reading of the table break points.
notes: Suspension/wheel-hop/body-bounce class. Parallax validity: at ranges under ~1 km, suspension heave (~cm) contributes angular motion comparable to this preset; the pure-rotation model under-represents short-range ground-to-ground FMV.
